_about: Frozen chat eval for TER-AI v0.8. Written before the Chat code existed (2026-10-16). Do not edit; add a new file for new cases. A turn is scored only if it has checks. expect_all: every string must appear in the reply. expect_any: at least one must appear. expect_none: none may appear. expect_regex: the regex must match. restart: save the session, load a new Chat from the same file, then send the turn. Clock fixed at 'now' (Asia/Bangkok wall time), random seed fixed at 'seed'. Honesty spec: a reply that cannot answer must say so with 'ไม่รู้' or 'ไม่มีข้อมูล'. Greeting spec (Bogus): 'สวัสดีครับ/ค่ะ' + 'มีอะไรให้ช่วยครับ/คะ'.
